destinations.title: praatMaar — Destinations
destinations.intro: Destinations let you choose by voice where your next recording goes. Say the destination name in a short recording to activate it; say default, standard, or standaard to return to the default folder.
destinations.empty: No custom destinations yet. The Default row is always available; click Add to create your own.
destinations.intro.line1: Dictate the name of a destination to write there — for example "Q3 Minutes".
destinations.intro.line3: Short, unique names work best; the name must be spoken exactly.
destinations.default_hint: Default belongs to the app and always stays.
destinations.footer_note: Transcripts are plain text files — local, no cloud.
destinations.name.hint: Say this to switch. Short and unique works best.
destinations.auto_paste.title: Automatically paste
destinations.auto_paste.hint: Puts the text on the clipboard and pastes into the active field.

modules.title: praatMaar — Modules
modules.intro: Enable or disable extensions. All dictation cycle events are also written to the event journal (events/events.jsonl) for external tools.
modules.intro_short: Modules are built-in extensions. Turn on what you need; everything runs locally.
modules.incremental: Incremental transcription (interim during recording; final always full pass)
modules.incremental_hint: Writes along while you dictate (for modules/tools); on stop a full final transcription always runs. Applies to the whole app.
modules.saved_actions_ready: Saved — actions are ready to use.
modules.meeting_buddy.dependency_hint: Works with Audio capture and Speech-to-text.
modules.inbox_mirror.name: Inbox mirror
modules.inbox_mirror.description: Copies each saved transcript to the inbox folder for external processing.
modules.speaker_detection.name: Speaker Detection
modules.speaker_detection.description: Assigns speaker roles (me/other/unknown) from audio source; available to other modules via capabilities.
modules.audio_capture.name: Audio capture
modules.audio_capture.description: Continuously captures microphone audio on Windows in segments while a module keeps a capture session running. Optionally mixes in meeting audio via WASAPI loopback (experimental). Other modules can consume that stream for live transcription. Short dictation recordings are separate.
modules.speech_to_text.name: Speech to text
modules.speech_to_text.description: Turns a continuous audio stream into live transcript deltas locally via Whisper. Runs alongside short dictation; active dictation takes priority for the model.
modules.meeting_buddy.name: Meeting Buddy
modules.meeting_buddy.description: Tracks agenda topics, questions, and action items locally and shows useful meeting hints.
modules.meeting_buddy.dialog.title: Meeting Buddy
modules.meeting_buddy.dialog.agenda_head: Agenda (one topic per line). Leave empty to start without an agenda.
modules.meeting_buddy.dialog.start_promp:
Agenda (one topic per line). Leave empty to start without an agenda.

Meeting Buddy listens automatically via the microphone — you do not need to start dictation with the hotkey.
modules.meeting_buddy.dialog.already_run: A meeting is already running. Use ‘Stop meeting’ to end it.
modules.meeting_buddy.dialog.empty_agend: Add at least one agenda topic.
